notes.notes:
The release of The Searchers of Legends: Origin on Steam with a 40% discount.
The game was released in early access and is in alpha development stage, at the moment only the first episode is available, the next episode is scheduled for the middle - the beginning of August. The next update is scheduled for 07/11/2019.
